#  Rebooting software deliveryfor humans and agentshumansagentsin the AI era
The software delivery stack was built for human workflows at human speed, and it no longer holds. Agents ship at volume; vibe-coded apps need the shortest path to production. So we are rebooting the stack:   
the obsolete rituals and ceremonies go, and what is left is a smaller set of tools with the automation already built into them.
